response.description:
Announcing the general availability of the service tag match
condition for Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF) custom rules on Azure Front
Door Premium. Service tags represent groups of IP address prefixes used by
Azure services, and Microsoft updates them automatically as addresses change.
Custom rules can now match a HTTP request's source IP address against service
tags, so you can control traffic from Azure services without building and
maintaining lists of IPs.  With service tag matching, you can: Allow Azure services your
application relies on, such as monitoring and health checks, through to your
endpoints. Block traffic from Azure
services your application never expects to receive requests from. Restrict sensitive paths,
such as admin endpoints, by combining a service tag with URI, host, or request
method conditions. Rate limit traffic from an
Azure service instead of blocking it outright. Learn
more.
response.title: Generally Available: Service tag match condition for Azure Front Door Premium WAF
